name: W San Francisco
positioning: A design-forward W hotel in San Francisco's SoMa district, near Moscone Center and SFMOMA, with downtown views and Gold Rush-inspired rooms
best_for: Convention-goers and travelers who want to be near Moscone Center and SFMOMA
Travelers who want a lively, design-led hotel with downtown views

facts.text: The hotel is in SoMa, near Moscone Center and SFMOMA.
The hotel is close to downtown sights such as Union Square and Oracle Park.
Each room has a signature W Hotels Bed with a pillow-top mattress, bedside tech hookups and a W Mix Bar.
Rooms and suites are designed around San Francisco's gold mining history.
The Premier Terrace has space to lounge and overhead heat lamps.
Many two-room suites have a living room and one or two bathrooms with Davines amenities.
Rooms have goose-down duvets and a pillow menu.
The FIT gym's machines are circled under a massive skylight.
The Living Room Bar is a lively space with vibrant lights and music.
The hotel's Whatever/Whenever service handles guest requests at any hour.
Pets are welcome, and dogs and cats receive a W Hotels pet bed and bowls on arrival.

highlights.text: The Premier Terrace rooms have a beveled tent structure for an indoor-outdoor glamping experience.
The hotel keeps bees on its 31st-floor rooftop, and their honey goes into cocktails.
The hotel was the first existing building in North America to receive LEED-EB Platinum certification.
Rooms and suites have sweeping views of downtown San Francisco.
The lobby has a black check-in desk that glows pink and purple beneath a light-up map of San Francisco.

considerations.text: A daily destination fee is charged; it includes a food and beverage credit, SFMOMA tickets, e-bike rentals and enhanced internet.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may be busy for some guests.
